OrderRecord.title: OrderRecord
OrderRecord.description: Represents a customer order in Waffleo POS across Active Queue, Done History, and Cancelled History. Deletion is permanently prohibited; orders can only be transitioned to CANCELLED.

userId.description: Workspace ID or UID of the authenticated Google account.

sequenceIndex.description: Queue ordering number so edited orders stay in their original queue position.

orderMedia.description: Order channel determining platform pricing and customer data prefix.

customerData.description: Customer name or prefixed platform order ID (GF - ..., F - ..., # ...).

itemsSummary.description: Readable summary of ordered items and customizations.

itemsPayload.description: Serialized line items with toppings, half-and-half, flavour, add-ons, sweetness, and ice level.

promoCode.description: Applied Waffleo promo identifier if any.

subtotalAmount.description: Order subtotal in IDR before promo discount.

paidAmount.description: Total amount already paid by customer in IDR.

cashReceivedAmount.description: Actual cash/tendered amount received from customer in IDR.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used (Tunai, QRIS, Cash + QRIS, Platform, Belum Bayar).

isPaid.description: Whether the current totalAmount is fully paid.

isPrepared.description: One-way kitchen preparation status flag (Prepare -> Prepared).

cancelReason.description: Reason selected when order is cancelled.

cancelledBy.description: Username and role of staff who cancelled the order.

cancelledAtText.description: Formatted timestamp when order was cancelled.

shortfallAmount.description: Additional payment required after an order edit increases total above paidAmount.

changeDueAmount.description: Cash refund/change due to customer after an order edit decreases total below paidAmount.

splitCashAmount.description: Cash portion in IDR when using split payment (Cash + QRIS).

splitQrisAmount.description: QRIS portion in IDR when using split payment (Cash + QRIS).

createdBy.description: Staff username who created or last updated the order.

paymentLedgerPayload.description: Serialized JSON array of payment ledger entries.

orderTimelinePayload.description: Serialized JSON array of order timeline events.

createdAt.description: Server or backdated timestamp when order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when order was last updated.

CatalogRecord.title: CatalogRecord
CatalogRecord.description: Stores editable POS master data: Menu items (Egg Waffle toppings, Drinks), Modifiers (Flavour, Add-on, Sweetness, Ice), Promos, and Branch configs.

userId.description: Workspace ID or UID of the authenticated Google account.

name.description: Display name of the menu item, modifier, promo, or branch.

category.description: Category or group (e.g. Egg Waffle, Drinks, FLAVOUR, ADD_ON, SWEETNESS, ICE).

metadataJson.description: Structured metadata (subCategory, platform prices, promo rules, or branch configs).

imageUrl.description: Product illustration key or URL synced across devices.

isActive.description: Whether this item/option is active and selectable in POS.

AuditLogRecord.title: AuditLogRecord
AuditLogRecord.description: Immutable append-only audit trail recording all data creations, edits, cancellations, and store status changes.

userId.description: Workspace ID or UID of the authenticated Google account.

actorUsername.description: Staff username who performed the action.

actorRole.description: Role of the staff member (Developer, Owner, Supervisor, Kasir).

actionType.description: Action code (e.g. ORDER_CREATED, ORDER_EDITED, ORDER_CANCELLED, ORDER_DONE, CATALOG_UPDATED, BRANCH_CREATED, STORE_STATUS).

beforeSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the data before change.

afterSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the data after change.

MoneyTransactionDoc.title: MoneyTransactionDoc
MoneyTransactionDoc.description: Real-time cloud-synced Money Manager transaction record (Income, Expense, Transfer).

StaffAccountDoc.title: StaffAccountDoc
StaffAccountDoc.description: Real-time cloud-synced branch staff account credentials and role.

BranchProfileDoc.title: BranchProfileDoc
BranchProfileDoc.description: Real-time cloud-synced multi-branch metadata created by Developer so all devices discover every branch (e.g. Global, Cabang Gabek).

WorkspaceSettingsDoc.title: WorkspaceSettingsDoc
WorkspaceSettingsDoc.description: Real-time cloud-synced POS workspace settings (bank accounts, digital wallets, custom categories/subcategories, store operational state).

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: POS orders collection storing Active, Done, and Cancelled orders. Delete is permanently blocked.

/users/{userId}/catalog/{itemId}.description: POS master catalog storing menu items, modifiers, promos, and branch configs.

/users/{userId}/branch_profiles/{branchD.description: Cloud-synced branch profiles so any device can discover and log into any branch.

/users/{userId}/workspace_settings/{sett.description: Cloud-synced POS settings (banks, digital wallets, custom categories, store status).
